name: security-foundations
description: Diagnoses your security posture from the foundations and builds an evidence-based control plan.

interface.longDescription: Diagnoses your security posture from the foundations and builds an evidence-based control plan. Every answer has four parts: asset and blind-spot diagnosis, a layered control matrix with standard references, an executable runbook, and verification with residual risk. Aligned with NIST CSF 2.0, ISO/IEC 27001:2022, SP 800-61r3, SP 800-63B Rev.4, OWASP Agentic Top 10 2026 and SLSA v1.2. Advisory only: it never runs changes or reads secrets.
capabilities: Diagnose security posture and asset gaps
Design layered controls with standard references
defaultPrompt: An employee opened a phishing attachment and their PC is acting strange. What do we do first?
We want to connect AI agents and MCP servers to our systems. Design the guardrails and approval steps.
A critical patch for an actively exploited bug just came out. Should we wait a week because of supply chain risk?
